modelingNotes: Atrium Building, Design Center of the Carolinas, 127 W. Worthington Ave, South End, Charlotte — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-atrium-building.ts

The campus's two-storey brick industrial building north of the Plaza Building, across the alley, and named for its glass-roofed central atrium: a flat-roofed red-brick block behind a plain parapet with two raised skylight monitors on its long axis, a stair tower and a one-storey strip on the alley side, and its entrance (127) on Worthington Ave.

Evidence: - OSM: way/432929165 ("Atrium Building", industrial, 2 levels). No parts. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 0.5 m (lowest ground under the footprint 219.7 m NAVD88 = y 0, on the Hawkins St side; ground rises ~1.2 m east). Above base: the roof 10.7 m, parapets 11.2–11.9 m, the north skylight monitor 14.2 m, the south monitor 13.1 m, the stair tower 12.0 m, the alley strip's west end 5.5 m. - USGS NAIP (public domain): the plan and the dark grey roof. - Photos (Wikimedia Commons, City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, April 2024): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Atrium_at_the_Design_Center_of_the_Carolinas_Mid-April_2024.jpg (the 127 entrance: brick colour, blue door frame) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Design_Center_Alley_Mid-April_2024.jpg (the alley between this and the Plaza Building)

Window treatment and brick follow clt-plaza-building, the Nebel mill's two rows of steel windows (clt-design-center). Estimated: window bays on every face, the alley strip's east part (4.5 m; the 2016 lidar shows it open, OSM includes it).

Doubts: no licensed photo shows a whole face of this building; the facade is the campus treatment, not observed. The OSM outline runs 7 m further south than the 2016 lidar's full-height roof; the model keeps OSM's extent with that strip low.
Model frame: bearing 30, as clt-design-center; metres above the base.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-atrium-building", model "clt-atrium-building"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-atrium-building.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
